title: gate blocks advance on tool caches it already knows are tool output; delete them instead
detail: sprint-cost: the building→reviewing advance blocked twice on .ruff_cache/.mypy_cache in the worktree, recreated by the full-suite run that prove requires right before advancing. The gate names them as unambiguous tool output and says 'delete NOW'. The block carries no information and costs a main-thread turn at ~130K each time. Candidate: the advance removes the known tool-cache dirs from worktrees itself and prints one line naming what it removed. Anything not on the known-cache list still blocks.
